mapper.sql: SELECT i.id AS identity_id, i.display_name AS identity_name, t.id AS tenant_id, t.name AS tenant_name, m.id AS membership_id, m.version FROM identity i JOIN membership m ON m.identity_id = i.id JOIN tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE NOT i.deleted AND NOT m.deleted AND NOT t.deleted AND i.status = 'active' AND m.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'active'
mapper.select: SELECT id AS identity_id, password_hash FROM identity WHERE NOT deleted AND status = 'active' AND (account = #{account} OR lower(email) = lower(#{account}))
AND i.id = #{identityId} ORDER BY t.name, m.id
AND i.id = #{identityId} AND m.id = #{membershipId} AND t.id = #{tenantId}
